sent_to_model:
Need help replying to Bethan, email below. Shes pulled out of Nia's hen because of the row with Lowri and now Lowri's gone all cold on her too, honestly the pair of them. I want to talk Beth round to coming, even just for the Saturday. Just to her not reply all, I'm not getting dragged in on the group one. Don't want it sounding like I'm taking sides or giving her a row, she'll dig her heels in if I do. Just landed off a Lagos so my head's mush, the bits I want in are below. Remind her I swapped Orlando with Kerry for this, and about Margam. Tell her I'll pick her up and she can share my room, and to hang on before paying Lowri.

- swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry from work to get the hen weekend off, cost me a night stop I really wanted
- Nia's wedding is 17th April at Margam, Beth is doing a reading
- Beth only needs to be at Tenby for 6 Saturday, could get the train from Cardiff Central, 2.5 hrs ish, I can pick her up from the station
- she can kip in with me Saturday night, I've got the twin room
- row with Lowri was at Lowri's 40th in Nov, Beth said something about Lowri's ex and it went from there, both said things
- Nia rang me crying last week asking if Beth was still coming, she doesnt know Beth's pulled out yet
- Beth sat with Nia in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019
- think Lowri's sorry really, she's just stubborn same as Beth
- Beth will regret it, Nia will remember who wasn't there
- get her to at least come Saturday for the meal, skip the cottage Friday if she wants
- tell her not to send Lowri the money yet
- not lecture her

Thread: Re: Nia's hen - Tenby final plan + money!!
(I'm Siân Pritchard here. I'm replying to Bethan Rees's message of 2027-02-09T07:52:00.)

---

From: Lowri Bevan | 2027-02-08T20:14:00
Hiya girls!!

Right, final plan for Nia's hen, PLEASE read all of it this time.

Friday 12th March - meet at the cottage in Tenby from 4ish (Gwel y Môr, it's on the hill above North Beach, I'll send the pin). Bring your own drinks for Friday night, I'm doing a chilli.
Saturday 13th - paddleboarding at 11 (wetsuits provided, don't panic Bethan), then the big meal at Caffi Harbwr at 7.30, I've booked the back room. Fancy dress is 'Nia through the ages', you get a year and you come as her. I'll send years out separately so it's a surprise.
Sunday - check out by 10, fry up on the way home.

Money: cottage was £510 split 6 ways so £85 each, I've already paid it so send it to me by the end of the month please. Paddleboarding is £38 pay on the day. Meal is set menu £42.

Nia knows NOTHING about the fancy dress so keep your mouths shut!!

Lowri xx

---

[the message I'm replying to] From: Bethan Rees | 2027-02-09T07:52:00
Morning all.

I've had a think about it and I'm going to give this one a miss. I don't really think I'd be very welcome to be honest, and I'm not going to spend a whole weekend in a cottage pretending everything's fine when it isn't. Some people know what I'm talking about.

I'll send Nia something nice myself and I'll see her at the wedding.

Lowri if you want the £85 for my share I'll send it, I don't want anyone out of pocket because of me.

B

---

From: Lowri Bevan | 2027-02-09T08:31:00
Ok. Your choice Bethan. Don't worry about the money.

(About me: flight attendant, 38, Cardiff, Wales. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)
